purpose: Paraphrased public clinical context only. Never patient evidence or a diagnostic rulebook.

snippets.title: Kidney history requires longitudinal context
snippets.text: Chronic kidney disease assessment concerns abnormalities persisting for at least three months. One low eGFR during an acute illness cannot establish chronicity; retrieve longitudinal measurements and the clinician assessment.

snippets.title: COPD history needs clinical and spirometry context
snippets.text: COPD diagnosis requires appropriate clinical context and spirometry assessment. An inhaler or a respiratory symptom alone is insufficient to establish the diagnosis.

snippets.title: Atrial-fibrillation assessment relies on rhythm evidence
snippets.text: NICE recommends a 12-lead ECG to diagnose suspected atrial fibrillation when an irregular pulse is detected. Review the tracing interpretation; anticoagulant use alone does not establish the indication.

snippets.title: Prototype documentation policy: diabetes
snippets.text: This demonstration surfaces a recent explicit external clinician assessment for reconciliation. Isolated laboratory results, medications and demographic risk never establish a condition within this software.

snippets.title: Prototype documentation policy: heart failure
snippets.text: Review the external clinician assessment and supporting cardiac workup. A historical BNP result or diuretic prescription alone is not adequate patient-specific support in this demonstration.

snippets.title: Prototype documentation policy: depression
snippets.text: Review the clinician's assessment and whether it was provisional or superseded. Medication use or a symptom mention alone does not establish a depression history in this demonstration.
